items.en: To succeed or happen as planned.
items.ex: The plan didn't quite come off as expected.

items.en: To visit someone's house.
items.ex: Why don't you come over for dinner tonight?

items.en: To be subjected to something, like attack or criticism.
items.ex: The government has come under heavy criticism.

items.en: To encounter difficulties or opposition.
items.ex: We came up against unexpected problems during the project.

items.en: To think or talk about something for a long time.
items.fa: در مورد چیزی فکر کردن، نشخوار فکری
items.ex: Don't dwell on past mistakes; focus on the future.

items.en: To dismiss employees due to economic reasons.
items.ex: The company had to lay off staff due to reduced demand.

items.en: To continue doing something despite difficulties.
items.ex: Despite the challenges, we must press on with our work.

items.en: To assemble or create something from parts.
items.ex: We need to put together a strong presentation.

items.en: to do something too quickly without thinking
items.fa: عجولانه عمل کردن، شتاب‌زده تصمیم گرفتن
items.ex: Don't rush into making such an important decision.

items.en: To become comfortable and accustomed to a new place.
items.ex: It took a few weeks to settle in to my new apartment.

items.en: To remain in a place or continue in a job.
items.ex: He decided to stay on at university for his master's.

items.en: Start doing something with great energy and enthusiasm.
items.ex: She decided to throw herself into her new project.

items.en: To encourage someone to do something.
items.ex: The crowd urged on their team to score.
